name: PHRX 4047
title: Endocrine and Reproductive Systems
description: Develop and demonstrate depth and breadth of knowledge in the foundational sciences associated with gastrointestinal and genitourinary patient care. Apply foundational knowledge in prevention and/or treatment of commonly encountered gastrointestinal and genitourinary disease states.
requirement_description: PHRX 3004, PHRX 3005, PHRX 3010, PHRX 3014, and PHRX 3030; Open only School of Pharmacy PharmD program.
